sourceRevision: agent/integration-v2 CP032 local integration (commit identified by git log)
policy: Scope-limited Node/model-asset proofs do not promote browser, device, language-quality or native-compute gates.

gates.scope: approved Instruct GGUF emits real tokens in isolated single-thread Node/WASM, not a browser
gates.acceptance: Exact model/asset hashes match and actual generation completes under bounded CPU Worker lifecycle.
SHA-256 and GGUF metadata match the approved Instruct receipt in a runnable checkout.

gates.scope: Node build integrity and local static asset packaging
gates.acceptance: Pinned Wllama assets pass hashes; Node tests and model-free plus private bundles build.
Chromium loads the pinned GGUF and emits actual Worker tokens, stop and restart tested.
Real same-Falcon counterbalanced A/B on frozen holdout with independently scored whole-task outcomes and false-verify rate.
Unfamiliar non-template source facts produce correctly selected executable operations without omitted clauses or false verification.
Falcon-led residual-only repair succeeds on independently unseen tasks while preserving all prior checked components.

gates.scope: two-source ordering, version invalidation and <=7 actions
gates.acceptance: Both traversal directions and separate oracle reject stale or forged provenance, and independently checked composition changes real execution.
Versioned R1/R1D/R1DX shared states replay losslessly, reject stale proofs and show measured reuse savings beyond scheduling overhead.

gates.scope: bounded exact arithmetic and Boolean on supported grammars
gates.acceptance: A typed supported request computes with independent exact checking and no model call.
Full/sparse/DELTA2 matrix paths pass independent numerical oracles and recurrence invalidation at measured crossover sizes.
Persisted checked Compass/joint policy changes yield held-out benefit over calibrated conservative baseline at comparable cost.

gates.scope: typed browser Worker capability and mocked cancellation/denial
gates.acceptance: Allowed operations execute in a bounded Worker and unsafe model proposals allocate no Worker.
Optional isolated Linux guest safely executes untrusted bounded workloads with OS-level termination, network/filesystem policies and no default daemon requirement.

gates.scope: developer-only exact integer DAG scheduling; 381 assertions and no measured physical parallelism
gates.acceptance: Actual browser Workers or isolated TinyLinux tasks implement bounded resource budgets, cancel/abort propagation, independently replayed outputs and measured serial-vs-parallel whole-task benefit, including V-FLOPS and real hardware.
Official pinned Coder optional path passes its own SHA/runtime/license and same-device sequential/concurrent comparisons without changing V1 default.
Typed TRM worker candidate is proven against exact/Falcon baselines without implicitly adding unapproved active model weights.
Source-linked selective retrieval verifies origin, freshness, content identity, scope, permission and stale-source withdrawal on real documents.
Real browser first-run model load, disconnect/revisit, stop, storage migration, privacy network trace and no model egress all pass.
Physical mobile and desktop UX, animated orb, accessibility, RAM/thermal/power and p95 quality gates pass on named hardware.
Owner/Shafi signs off license/privacy evidence, model quality, rollback rehearsal and tested release candidate.
